Q: Does lock blocking make a ModifiedDate watermark sync safe? A:

When a new row is inserted into the table, the row gets an X lock.

The reason you are seeing this behaviour is that you don't have an index on ModifiedDate, so the SELECT needs to scan the whole table, at which point it gets blocked by the X lock. When the lock is released it continues.

You should have an index anyway, to make this more efficient.

CREATE TABLE dbo.MyTable
(
    Id            int IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    Name          varchar(50)       NOT NULL,   
    ModifiedDate  datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (GETDATE()),
    CONSTRAINT    PK_MyTable PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id),
    INDEX IX_ModifiedDate (ModifiedDate)
);

Now you should find that a SELECT which seeks after your new value will not be blocked.

The real solution to your problem is that the SELECT is wrong. The client should hold on to the most recent row it receives, and seek from that and order the rows in ModifiedDate order. At which point it will get blocked again by the new insert. So it never misses an earlier row which was committed later, as such a row will have always blocked the previous SELECT from proceeding until it is committed.

SELECT * 
FROM MyTable
WHERE ModifiedDate > '2026-07-26 04:00:00'
ORDER BY ModifiedDate;

Q: VsCode - Triggering a snippet upon file creation A:

Added later to vscode see How can I create templates for file extensions in Visual Studio Code

Check out this extension: Auto Snippet:

With this in your settings.json:

"autoSnippet.snippets": [
  { "pattern": "**/main.go", "snippet": "main-go-template" },
],

[Note that the example settings in the extension docs has a few syntax errors - use my example above - I have filed an issue with the creator.]

And then your snippet

"main-go-template": {
  "prefix": "zz",
  "body": [
    ...  // you can use tabstops and transforms just like regular snippets
  ]
  "description": "javascript template"
}

Then creating a new main.go file or opening an empty one should trigger the snippet.

It is a good idea to reload vscode whenever you make a change to this extension's settings.

Also see this extension https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=bam.vscode-file-templates

Q: Warning C6387 Visual Studio A:

In Visual Studio you can use the 'Source-code Annotation Language' (SAL) to tell IntelliSense about your check for NULL by adding

_Analysis_assume_(hwnd != NULL);

between the opening brace and the call to GetClientRect().

Q: Is there a quick way to edit snippets for the current language? A:

You can't do what you want with any existing command, but if you run a series of commands and use vscode's extension you can. Using Find and Transform (an extension I wrote) you can do what you need.

A keybinding for your keybindings.json:

  {
    "key": "alt+s",                      // whatever you want 
    "command": "findInCurrentFile",
    "args": {
      "description": "Open local file snippets path", // whatever you want here
      "run": [
        "$${",
        "const langID = document.languageId;",

        "const userSnippetsUri = vscode.Uri.joinPath(context.globalStorageUri, '..', '..', 'snippets');",

        "const uri = vscode.Uri.joinPath(userSnippetsUri, langID + '.json');",
        "vscode.commands.executeCommand('vscode.open', uri);",
        "}$$",
      ],
      "runWhen": "onceIfAMatch"
    }
  }

Its the current editor's languageID and then the location of the snippets directory and uses those to open, for example, html.json or javascript.json of the snippets directory.

Note, I can't test it on other OS's but it may already work as is. If you find it doesn't work on your OS, let me know.

Q: SVG - Adding Hyperlink with Query String A:

Some characters in XML have structural meaning. It's obvious that < and > are used for elements but there are a few others too. In order to represent some characters and not have them confused with markup XML has 5 built in entities.

  • " becomes "
  • & becomes &
  • ' becomes '
  • < becomes <
  • > becomes >
